Observations
After two weeks, we observe that : =~
- The plant in the red cup grew taller than the plant -
in the blue cup.
- The plant in the red cup has four leaves with dark
green color, while the plant in the blue cup has two k
small leaves with pale green (yellow) color.
Conclusions
- Sunlight is a basic need for the plants like water and air.
- Sunlight is important to plant growth, because plants use sunlight to make their
own food, so the plant without sunlight does not grow well because it had less food.
